individuals.title: Wikimedia Enterprise
individuals.quote: is a service of the Wikimedia Foundation available via enterprise.wikimedia.com

individuals.title: Wikimedia Foundation
individuals.quote: primary decision making for it will rest with the Wikimedia Foundation

individuals.title: Build services for high-volume reusers
individuals.quote: The goal of the service is to build services for high-volume commercial reusers of Wikimedia content.

individuals.title: Barrier to entry for Wikimedia data
individuals.quote: There is a very high barrier to entry for using Wikimedia data, outside of the common use cases of reading or editing.

individuals.title: Few massive companies use Wikimedia data
individuals.quote: It is well known that a few massive companies use our projects' data.

individuals.title: Community feeling that companies should reinvest
individuals.quote: There has long been a feeling among community members that these companies should do more to reinvest in the Wikimedia communities

individuals.title: Democratize data for organizations without large resources
individuals.quote: there is a responsibility to democratize our data for organizations that do not possess the resources of these largest users

individuals.title: Access for all principle
individuals.quote: in accordance with the project's principle of *access for all*

individuals.title: Non-exclusivity principle
individuals.quote: In accordance with the Wikimedia Enterprise operating principles regarding non-exclusivity, any newly developed software feature or dataset must be made available to all.

individuals.title: Wikimedia content remains libre
individuals.quote: Wikimedia projects are, have always been, and will always remain *libre*.

individuals.title: Copyright licensing compliance constraint
individuals.quote: All users of Wikimedia Enterprise services must abide by the copyright licenses on Wikimedia content.

individuals.title: Exceptional access only after standard options
individuals.quote: Exceptional free access to a paid account can only be granted when all standard options are exhausted

individuals.title: Offering not required for for-profit reuse
individuals.quote: Use of this offering will not be required for for-profit content reuse

individuals.title: Enterprise API revenue supports mission
individuals.quote: All Enterprise API revenue will unequivocally be used to support the Wikimedia mission

individuals.title: Regular current snapshots requirement
individuals.quote: Regular current snapshots of Wikimedia projects

individuals.title: Dependable accessible infrastructure requirement
individuals.quote: Dependable, accessible infrastructure

individuals.title: Best last revision requirement
individuals.quote: a “best last revision”

individuals.title: Movement Strategy recommendation to explore earned income
individuals.quote: Explore new opportunities for both revenue generation and free knowledge dissemination through partnerships and earned income

individuals.title: Movement Strategy recommendation to improve API suite
individuals.quote: Make the Wikimedia API suite more comprehensive, reliable, secure and fast, in partnership with large scale users

individuals.title: Program goal: Content
individuals.quote: Make more of our movement's content available in consistent machine-readable formats

individuals.title: Program goal: Resource-load
individuals.quote: Reduce the need for high-intensity site-scraping by the highest-frequency and highest-volume reusers

individuals.title: Program goal: Fundraising
individuals.quote: Provide a clearer and more consistent way for the largest re-users to reinvest derived benefits back to the movement

individuals.title: Exceptional free access
individuals.quote: you may request free **exceptional access** to the higher rate of the Enterprise APIs

individuals.title: Exceptional access review criteria
individuals.quote: Requests will be reviewed by *Wikimedia Foundation* staff in accordance with the following criteria

individuals.title: Mission alignment criterion
individuals.quote: Is the intended use case aligned with any of the needs identified in the Movement Strategy Recommendations?

individuals.title: Values alignment criterion
individuals.quote: Do the requester’s professional practices or business model align with Wikimedia’s values?

individuals.title: Human rights assessment
individuals.quote: A human rights assessment is undertaken by the WMF for certain users of paid accounts

individuals.title: Wikimedia Cloud Services
individuals.quote: Using Wikimedia Cloud Services.

individuals.title: Paid access to Enterprise APIs
individuals.quote: The primary use case of the suite of Enterprise APIs is paid access for large commercial organisations

individuals.title: Free Enterprise API account
individuals.quote: Creating a free account on the official website and using the Enterprise API access for free accounts

individuals.title: Service Level Agreements
individuals.quote: Contracted accounts receive 99% SLA and support response-time guarantees.

individuals.title: Snapshot API
individuals.quote: The Enterprise Snapshot API allows users to retrieve entire Wikimedia projects as a database dump file.

individuals.title: On-demand API
individuals.quote: The Wikimedia Enterprise On-demand API allows users to retrieve single articles from any supported Wikimedia project at anytime.

individuals.title: Realtime API
individuals.quote: The Enterprise Realtime API allows users to stream updates in real-time from any supported Wikimedia project.

individuals.title: Streaming feature
individuals.quote: Streaming: Receive streaming (firehose) updates of every change as they occur in real-time

individuals.title: Event filtering feature
individuals.quote: Filtering of events by Project or Revision Namespace

individuals.title: Batch download feature
individuals.quote: Batch: Download compressed files of all articles that were changed, generated hourly

individuals.title: Structured Contents datasets
individuals.quote: Downloading Structured Contents (beta) datasets hosted on third-party platforms

individuals.title: Wikimedia content
individuals.quote: The full corpus of Wikimedia content always has been, and will continue to be, made available for reuse

individuals.title: EventStream platform
individuals.quote: Reusers that use an infrastructure reliant on the EventStream platform depend on services like RESTBase

individuals.title: Commercial Partnerships division
individuals.quote: The Wikimedia Enterprise project is helmed by the **Commercial Partnerships** division

individuals.title: Advancement Department
individuals.quote: which sits under the Advancement Department in the Wikimedia Foundation

individuals.title: Wikimedia Deutschland
individuals.quote: the request will be reviewed in coordination with staff from *Wikimedia Deutschland*

individuals.title: Wikimedia Enterprise LLC
individuals.quote: The board of the LLC overseeing the project

individuals.title: Wikimedia Foundation Board of Trustees
individuals.quote: The LLC is subject to the governance of the Wikimedia Foundation Board of Trustees

individuals.title: Sheetal Puri
individuals.quote: This includes the Chief Advancement Officer Sheetal Puri

individuals.title: Stephen LaPorte
individuals.quote: General Counsel Stephen LaPorte

individuals.title: Selena Deckelman
individuals.quote: Chief Product and Technology Officer Selena Deckelman

individuals.title: Lane Becker
individuals.quote: Lane Becker who serves as the LLC's president

individuals.title: PartnerHero
individuals.quote: PartnerHero provide customer support services

individuals.title: Vuurr
individuals.quote: Vuurr are assisting our sales process

individuals.title: Super Natural Design
individuals.quote: Super Natural Design are the designers of the project website

individuals.title: Speed & Function
individuals.quote: Engineering support was provided in the first years by

individuals.title: Perrine Winkler
individuals.quote: Perrine Winkler has been contracted to help with rebranding the team behind Enterprise

individuals.title: Enterprise project team
individuals.quote: The Enterprise project team is developing a new resource aimed at for-profit content reusers

individuals.title: Wikimedia API team
individuals.quote: allows the Wikimedia API team to focus on volunteers, teams, and organizations

individuals.title: For-profit content reusers
individuals.quote: aimed at for-profit content reusers, who have product, service, and system requirements that go beyond what we freely provide

individuals.title: High-volume commercial reusers
individuals.quote: high-volume commercial reusers of Wikimedia content

individuals.title: Universities and university researchers
individuals.quote: for universities and university researchers

individuals.title: Archives and archivists
individuals.quote: archives and archivists

individuals.title: Wikimedia movement
individuals.quote: along with the wider Wikimedia movement

individuals.title: Wikimedia community members
individuals.quote: in the Wikimedia communities for the benefits they gain from the content and resources they use
